# mailboxorg Provider

Manage mailbox.org through its JSON-RPC API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    mailboxorg = {
      source = "charpand/mailboxorg"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials can also come from MAILBOXORG_USERNAME and MAILBOXORG_PASSWORD.
provider "mailboxorg" {
  username = var.mailboxorg_username
  password = var.mailboxorg_password
}

variable "mailboxorg_username" {
  type = string
}

variable "mailboxorg_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Several logins in one configuration (for example a reseller login and the
# login of an account it manages): give each one an alias and credentials of
# its own, then pick it per resource or data source with `provider`.
provider "mailboxorg" {
  alias    = "reseller"
  username = var.reseller_username
  password = var.reseller_password
}

provider "mailboxorg" {
  alias    = "account"
  username = var.account_username
  password = var.account_password
}

data "mailboxorg_domain" "example" {
  provider = mailboxorg.account
  domain   = "example.com"
}

variable "reseller_username" {
  type = string
}

variable "reseller_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "account_username" {
  type = string
}

variable "account_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) API endpoint. Defaults to https://api.mailbox.org/v1/. Can also be set with MAILBOXORG_BASE_URL.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the API user. Can also be set with the MAILBOXORG_PASSWORD environment variable.
- `timeout` (Number) HTTP request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 60. Can also be set with MAILBOXORG_TIMEOUT.
- `username` (String) mailbox.org API user. Can also be set with the MAILBOXORG_USERNAME environment variable.
